sentences.text:
3. Vide order dated 05.09.2024, first application for suspension of execution of sentence was
dismissed as withdrawn by this Court.

Now this, second application for suspension of execution of
sentence
has been preferred.

4. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that learned trial court has erred in convicting and
sentencing the applicant as mentioned above.

Counsel submits that after rejection of first
application for suspension of execution of sentence, more than a year has been passed but till date,
the appeal has not been finally decided.

He submits that appellant-applicant has served
incarceration of nearly two years and seven months.

He also argues that there is no substantive
evidence against the appellant- applicant as victim as well as her parents did not support the
prosecution case and declared hostile.

He submits that conviction of the appellant-applicant is
based solely on the basis of Dna report.

He further submits that a Dna report is merely an opinion
of the expert and evidentiary value of the Dna is only corroborative and on the basis of such
corroborative piece of evidence, no conviction can be recorded in absence of substantial evidence
particularly when the victim and her family members have not supported the prosecution case.

In
these circumstances, it would be justified that the application is accepted and the execution of
sentence is suspended particularly when there is no prospect of final hearing of this appeal in near
future.

(Uploaded on 17/10/2025 at 05:36:30 Pm) [2025:Rj-Jp:42228] (3 of 4) [Sosa-523/2025]
5. Learned State counsel opposes the application for suspension of execution of sentence.

He
submits that it is true that victim of this case has not supported the prosecution case but it cannot be
ignored that on account of sexual exploitation, victim of this case became pregnant but her
pregnancy of three months was automatically aborted.

The product of conception of victim was sent
to Fsl for Dna examination and according to the Dna report, the appellant-applicant is the
biological father of the product of conception of victim.

Learned stated counsel also draws attention
of the Court towards the evidence of Dr. 9 Dr. Reena Meena.
He further submits that

victim/complainant has duly been informed about hearing of this application for suspension of
execution of sentence.
6. Despite information, no one has put in appearance on behalf of victim/complainant.

7. It is apparent from the record that neither efforts were made by counsel for the appellant to get
listed the appeal for final hearing nor matter was mentioned before the concerned Bench having
roster, therefore, merely period of incarceration cannot be a sole basis for entertaining the present
application for Sos.

Considering the overall facts and circumstances of the present case and also
considering the arguments advanced by learned counsel for the appellant-applicant as well as
learned Public Prosecutor and the material available on record including Dna report as per which
the source of male Dna profile obtained from product of conception of victim is biological son of
Vinod S/O Pankhi vs State Of Rajasthan (2025:Rj-Jp:42228) on 6 October, 2025
Indian

Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/184627540/
2

source of female Dna profile of the victim and Male Dna of the appellant (Uploaded on 17/10/2025
at 05:36:30 Pm) [2025:Rj-Jp:42228] (4 of 4) [Sosa-523/2025] and testimony of Pw-9 Dr. Rina
Meena, I am not incline
d to accept the instant application for suspension of execution of sentence.
8. Accordingly, this second application for suspension of execution of sentence is dismissed.
(ANIL KUMAR UPMAN),J LALIT MOHAN /33
